name: optimize_kotlin_immutable_list_accumulation
description: Optimizes an O(n^2) accumulation that rebuilds an immutable List with + on each iteration
prompts: Scaler.doubleEach in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Scaler.kt returns a new list containing every input element multiplied by two, in order. It accumulates with `acc = acc + (x * 2)` on an immutable List inside the loop, so each iteration copies the entire growing list - O(n^2) total, unusably slow for lists of a hundred thousand elements. Rewrite doubleEach to run in linear time (use a MutableList, buildList, or a single map) producing exactly the same list in the same order. Keep the object name and the doubleEach(xs: List<Int>): List<Int> signature. The file declares package com.optarena.app.
